correctness.rationale: Definitions fix precisely one root loop, a root parent map, arbitrary finite first-level branches and depth at most two. Two-variable definable unary types and all their atomic extension possibilities yield exactly twelve feasible classes. From width three, every f-term equality translates to at most three parent-relation names; variable recycling detects k children with k names, and a permanent pebbled-branch strategy proves sufficiency for all depths. The (k+1)^(k+1) count, unique minimal representatives, and strictness examples follow. 69 finite structures and independent refinements with 2,346+2,346+595+325 pair checks, plus 609 direct child-witness checks, all agreed; finite checks are not the proof.
